description: Angular component for configuring SNMP device transport settings, including form controls, validation, and state management.

classes.name: SnmpDeviceTransportConfigurationComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for SNMP device transport configuration.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form group and subscribes to form value changes.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group, returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates form with provided configuration value.

methods.name: isV3protocolVersion
methods.description: Checks if current protocol version is V3.

methods.name: updateDisabledFormValue
methods.description: Enables/disables form controls based on protocol version.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the external model with current form values if valid.
